description: This file defines the AprCalculator class, which computes the annual percentage rate (APR) based on various interest period types, interest rates, and repayment schedules within the loan scheduling domain of the Fineract project.

classes.name: AprCalculator
classes.description: A component class responsible for calculating the annual percentage rate (APR) based on interest period type, interest rate, and repayment schedule parameters.

methods.name: calculateFrom
methods.description: Calculates the annual nominal interest rate (APR) based on interest period type, interest rate per period, number of repayments, repayment frequency, and days in year type.
